title: Technical Sales Manager- South
description:

· Create plan and implement sales strategy, and strategic sales and business development initiatives, in alignment with global/local sales strategy. Achieves sales targets in respect of both budgets and sales efficiency.

· Establish sales targets and ensures sales achievement through regular oversight and definition and implementation of improvement plans as needed.

· Identifies opportunities at existing and potential new customers within defined geographical area, determines plans for acquisition and allocates resources.

· Coordinates the flow of information for sales activities and transactions, including leads, billings, orders, contracts, etc. and evaluates data to ensure achievement of goals.

· Supports the development of strong relationships with key customers. Builds and maintains strong relationships with key decision makers. Ensures efficient marketing communications

· Ensures achievement of sales volume and product mix targets by setting appropriate price and margin for sales. Participates on negotiations of key contracts.

· Takes ownership of the sales processes, and all relevant training and development plans, actions and programs.

· Ensures (with HR Manager support) that the area of responsibility is properly organized, staffed, skilled and directed. Coaches, motivates and develops direct and indirect subordinates within HR policies. Drives and ensures know-how sharing and cross-collaboration.

**Your background**

· Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Graduate with MBA

· Minimum 2 to 10 years of experience in the sales of HVAC related products and technologies

· Excellent knowledge on HVAC related processes

· Excellent communication skills with an ability to influence both internally and externally.

title: Field Sales Representative, Growth, Google Cloud, Startups
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in quota-carrying cloud or software sales, or consultative account management at a business-to-business (B2B) software company.
* Experience building relationships with internal teams and customer stakeholders.
* Experience prospecting, or building customer relationships from scratch.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling cloud solutions, infrastructure software, databases, analytic tools, or applications software to startups or digital native organizations, aligning solutions to drive business outcomes.
* Experience growing existing customer base and acquiring new logos at scale, to increase spend and accelerate consumption business.
* Experience working with, and leading, cross-functional teams and partners in implementations and negotiations.
* Experience working with Customer Engineers and customers' technical leads to inventory software estate, define migration plans, and build migration business cases.
* Experience cultivating C-level relationships and influencing executives.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Field Sales Representative (FSR), focused on new customer acquisition for accounts within the startup ecosystem, you will grow Google Cloud by acquiring new logos and securing the foundational workload(s) to accelerate their consumption business. You will drive long-term business growth by gaining a deep understanding of new customers' critical issues and aligning them with Google Cloud's portfolio of solutions. You will lead the business process, from initiating customer conversations to orchestrating internal and external teams to deliver business commitments and increased consumption. You will be a partner to cross-industry Startup and Digital Native accounts, engaging customers, from developers to C-suite founders, with consultative value selling methodology.
  
  
Google Cloud's unique capabilities empower Startups and Digital Natives to address critical needs in scaling, growth, and global expansion, while also offering advanced technologies that drive differentiation, customer acquisition, and business acceleration.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build and deepen relationships with enterprise customers, influence long-term direction and serve as a business partner.
* Lead account strategy in generating and developing business growth opportunities, work collaboratively with Customer Engineers and Google Partners to optimize business results in territory and open up opportunities with existing and prospective customers.
* Understand the technology footprint, growth plans, business drivers, and technology strategy of assigned accounts.
* Manage multiple opportunities through the entire business cycle simultaneously, work with cross-functional teams and serve as the primary customer contact for all business/adoption-related activities, including the development of agreements.
* Drive business development, forecast accurately, and achieve goals by leading customers through the entire business cycle.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Platform Specialist
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Apple Ads - Platform Specialist with a real passion for customer excellence to join our Search Ads team to help businesses with promotion and discovery across Apple Services. Operating as both a strategic account manager and a consultative seller across the pre- and post- sale lifecycle. Highly adaptable, self-directed, you are an autonomous problem solver who can independently troubleshoot complex campaign performance issues, architect bold growth strategies and constructively challenge clients to rethink their potential. Effectively partners with performance advertisers in the mobile and app developer ecosystem, you have very strong communication and interpersonal skills, you are highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, team-oriented, and can work independently to meet revenue and business objectives. You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in the mobile and app developer space with performance-type advertisers and agencies.  
  
**Description**  
Manage relationships with clients and agencies in the performance marketing space  
Maintain a high level of outreach via email, phone and meetings to ensure a strong business pipeline  
Develop a strategy for long-term success across your portfolio of clients & prospects  
Act as a thought leader with both clients and agencies  
Work closely with your Manager & Platform Specialist team to ensure accurate execution and alignment with customer objectives  
Use internal & external data sets to understand how to best help grow your customer's business  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Over 5 years in performance account management or sales, with a proven history of expanding existing client portfolios in search and mobile advertising.  
Comprehensive knowledge of the mobile app ecosystem, with specialized background and strong preference for experience within the mobile gaming landscape.  
Rigorous data fluency, with expert command of Excel/Numbers to dissect performance data and build compelling commercial narratives.  
Challenger mindset, skilled at guiding advertisers beyond their comfort zone using proactive, insight-led recommendations.  
Proven agency collaboration, comfortable navigating complex agency hierarchies and direct-advertiser relationships.  
Platform mastery, experienced in self-serve ad operations, campaign optimization, client training, and troubleshooting.  
India market expertise, well-versed in local digital dynamics as well as cross-border import/export business models.  
Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills, capable of delivering high-impact business reviews and articulating complex concepts clearly to senior stakeholders.  
High operational rigor, with meticulous attention to detail, proactive prioritization, and the resilience to execute under tight timelines.  
Completion of the official Apple Ads Certification, with a strong foundational understanding of the Apple Ads product suite, campaign structures, and best practices, is strongly preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree in a related field or equivalent, MBA a plus  
Experience in performance media sales with at least 4 years experience using a self-serve type platform  
Managed India-based clients with domestic and export business in your previous roles  
Experienced in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.  
Excellent communication and presentations skills - both in person and virtually

title: Process Excellence and Transformation- Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving measurable efficiency and transformation across CCB F&BM. Yes? You have found the right team.

As a Senior Associate, Process Excellence & Transformation within CCB Finance & Business Management (F&BM), you will spend each day building a centralized, persona-driven engagement model and creating a single source of truth for transformation use cases. You will be responsible for delivering quantifiable improvements through AI use cases, standardized governance, disciplined program/project management, and Lean (DMAIC) practices.

Our CCB F&BM transformation teams are responsible for a wide range of activities including identifying and prioritizing efficiency opportunities across sub‑LOBs, establishing consistent operating models and governance routines, and executing change that improves outcomes in a sustainable, well-controlled way.

Job Responsibilities
Build and maintain a living “golden resource” linking Team Technology

* Change Journey across sub‑LOBs.
* Design and operationalize a centralized, persona-driven engagement model, mapping job families to impacted users, themes, and adoption requirements.
* Source, intake, and prioritize thematic efficiency and AI transformation use cases across sub‑LOBs using standardized forms and processes.
* Document team/tool ownership, impacted processes, current status, and a 12–24 month roadmap to create a single source of truth.
  + Scale proof-of-concept work into production-ready artifacts that can be used in strategy discussions and before launching new use cases.
  + Align priorities and outcomes with sub‑LOB leadership (N‑1), clarifying ownership, decisions, and success measures.
* Standardize execution through Agile discipline and governance routines, including JIRA hygiene, review checkpoints, and timely sign-offs.
* Partner with Controls stakeholders to align initiatives to Controls OKRs, streamline SOPs, and identify control-aligned efficiency opportunities.
* Coordinate delivery with STO/execution partners by managing dependencies, tracking progress, and escalating risks and delays.
* Maintain a single authoritative repository for historical, current, and pipeline transformation work and enable leadership visibility via JIRA dashboards.
* Lead Lean (DMAIC) deep-dives to deliver measurable, systemic improvements with sub‑LOB sign-off and adoption.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

* Demonstrate 6+ years of experience in process excellence, transformation, program/project management, or operational strategy (financial services beneficial).
* Lead cross-functional workstreams with senior stakeholder alignment, including N‑1 engagement and decision-making.
* Active development experience to build solutions using IS solutions- Python, Pyspark, Alteryx
* Execute disciplined intake-to-delivery lifecycle management, including governance cadence, dependency/risk management, and closure.
* Apply hands-on Agile delivery practices and use JIRA for tracking, reporting, and dashboarding.
* Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including executive-ready updates and crisp decision asks.
* Build and sustain an adopted “golden resource” mapping Team–Tool–Process–Change Journey with a 12–24 month outlook.
* Deliver measurable outcomes through standardized operating models, reusable repositories, and end-to-end workstreams with documented stakeholder buy-in.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

* Active development experience to build solutions using IS solutions- Databricks, Snowflake, Atoti, Sigma, Tableau
  + Apply exposure to intelligent automation and analytics enablement and adoption in enterprise environments.
* Hold Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt/Black Belt) or demonstrate successful DMAIC delivery experience.

title: Blue Yonder Functional Consultant
description:
### **Blue Yonder Solutions Consultant**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Blue Yonder Solutions Consultant to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and optimizing Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) supply chain planning and execution solutions for our diverse client base. This role requires a deep understanding of supply chain processes, strong technical aptitude, and excellent client-facing communication skills to deliver successful project outcomes and drive operational excellence.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Production support**

* Own L2/L3 functional support for our cloud-hosted Demand360 environment. Blue Yonder provides product support, so this is an analysis and ownership role, not development.
* Triage and root-cause production issues such as forecast anomalies, missing or incorrect forecasts, batch/workflow failures, and data load problems.
* Determine whether the cause is internal (AS400 feeds, sales history, item/location masters, promotion data, configuration, business process) or a Demand360 product issue.
* Trace data from AS400 backend jobs into Demand360, validate feed completeness, timing, and accuracy, and reconcile source-to-BY discrepancies.
* Raise and manage Service Requests (SRs) with Blue Yonder for product issues, with clear reproduction steps and evidence, and escalate when needed.
* Track issues to closure, keep stakeholders informed, and document root cause and fixes in a knowledge base and runbooks.

**Enhancements and change**

* Assess enhancement requests for feasibility: achievable through existing functionality or configuration, requires an internal AS400/interface change, or requires a Blue Yonder product change.
* Where BY is needed, document the gap and work with BY on scope, options, timelines, and cost.
* Deliver impact assessments (forecasting, data, interface, process) with a clear recommendation.

**Planner and business support**

* Support planners on forecast behavior, including statistical model outputs, overrides, promotions and events, new item handling, and hierarchy/aggregation questions.
* Analyze forecast accuracy and bias, separating data issues from model or configuration issues.

**Stakeholder and executive engagement**

* Work directly with business users to understand problems and explain findings in business terms.
* Present issue trends, enhancement recommendations, and vendor performance to senior leadership and executives.
* Act as the primary functional liaison between the business, internal IT/AS400 teams, and Blue Yonder.

**Release readiness**

* Review BY cloud release notes for impact on current processes and integrations.
* Support regression and UAT for BY releases and internal changes affecting Demand360.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive or process improvements.

### **Must Have**

* 8+ years of functional experience in demand planning or forecasting, with hands-on Blue Yonder Demand360 (or predecessor JDA/BY demand products) experience in a support, consulting, or planning analyst role.
* Experience supporting Blue Yonder in a cloud/SaaS environment, including managing SRs with BY Support through to closure.
* Strong grasp of forecasting concepts: statistical models, seasonality, promotions, new product introduction, forecast accuracy, and bias.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate root cause across integrated systems.
* Solid understanding of integration concepts: batch and file-based feeds, mapping, validation, and reconciliation.
* Proven ability to evaluate enhancement requests and translate business needs into functional requirements.
* Senior judgment: knows whether an issue is internal or a vendor product defect, and can defend that position with evidence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience presenting to executives and senior business leaders.
* Business fluency: explains forecasting and data findings simply and builds trust with planners and executives.
* Vendor management skills: organized and persistent in driving Blue Yonder to resolution.
* Able to work independently and own issues end to end, with strong documentation discipline (RCAs, impact assessments, runbooks).

### **Nice to Have**

* **Working knowledge of AS400 / IBM i:** job schedules, batch jobs, data files/tables, and program logic, enough to diagnose feed issues and talk credibly with AS400 developers (RPG/CL familiarity a plus).
* Basic SQL for querying and validating data on both the AS400 and BY sides.
* Industry experience in [retail / wholesale / distribution / manufacturing].
* Familiarity with downstream use of the forecast (replenishment, supply planning, or S&OP).
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira) and incident/problem management practices.
* Blue Yonder certifications.

description:
**Overview**

The **Commercial Executive** is a strategic negotiator within Microsoft's Enterprise Commercial organization, responsible for leading deal-making, negotiation, and collaboration activities to drive revenue growth and customer success.This role acts as a trusted advisor on commercial activities and contracting, leading internal and external sales through commercial construct and deal value proposition, while optimizing the right level of investment and customization. The Commercial Executive plays a key role in supporting AI transformation across accounts, maximizing business opportunities with new offerings (such as Copilot), and ensuring compliant, on-time deal execution. As a trusted advisor, the CE crafts and negotiates commercial solutions that are both compliant and profitable, aligning customer needs with Microsoft's business goals.

The role involves leading deal-making processes, optimizing customization through price and non-price concessions, defining complex negotiation strategies, and building trust-based relationships with stakeholders across customer, partner, and internal teams. The CE serves as a lead point for escalations and negotiations, develops and models commercial options, drives creative and transformative deal strategies, and continuously seeks revenue growth opportunities through up-selling and cross-selling — with a strong focus on supporting **AI Transformation** in every account (Copilot and new offerings).

Success is measured by impact on customer commercial strategy, achievement of quota and consumption targets, timely renewals, and compliant deal execution.

 **Responsibilities**

**Deal Making**

* Lead internal and external sales and management teams through commercial construct, optimizing for the right level of investment and customization.
* Optimize deal customization leveraging price and non-price concessions.
* Identify business opportunities that vary based on deal lifecycle and AI (Copilot and new offerings).
* Create and manage the commercial plan / contribute to the account plan for strategic accounts, mapping how to maximize qualified medium-to-complex commercial opportunities.
* Analyze customer commercial opportunity history, including discounts, concessions, and consumption across the territory.
* Anticipate and verify upcoming renewals; lead renewal processes with account teams to maximize on-time revenue and recapture rate.
* Construct compliant commercial solutions to maximize renewals.

* Close eligible workloads and expiring contracts

**Negotiation**

* Understand stakeholders and priorities; leverage formal negotiation strategies, anticipate potential vulnerabilities, understand customer measurement of value, and define walk-away positions.
* Consult with leaders on rhythm of negotiation team planning and reporting to stakeholders.
* Act as Trusted Advisor and Negotiation SME for deals negotiated by AEs or other stakeholders.
* Drive accountability for negotiation outcomes.
* Ensure adherence to commercial solutions policy for deal execution, including regulatory laws, local market principles, company policies, and guidance for consistent deal making.
* Prioritize "configuration" over "customization" in deals of all sizes; validate that a deployment plan is in place.

**Collaboration**

* Develop trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders, partners, and Account Teams to help customers deliver their business goals and achieve Microsoft revenue targets.
* Demonstrate in-depth and strategic understanding of Microsoft licensing programs and contracting.
* Collaborate with Internal and Partner teams.
* Understand and apply the Sales Cycle Framework; share accountability with the account team to drive Security and Usage; structure deals to drive usage.
* Consult with leadership and account team to ensure customer and teams are aligned on the value proposition of commercial programs.

**Compliance & Other**

* Embody Microsoft's culture and values.
* Model integrity and ethical behavior daily; full adherence to company policies and processes.
* Complete 100% of required Compliance Trainings by due date.
* Cooperate with audits, investigations, and remediation actions; proactively identify and escalate role-inherent risks.

 **Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Law, Marketing, Finance, Communication, Education (or equivalent) or related field AND 6+ years of sales and negotiation experience (or related work / internship experience) OR 8+ years of sales and negotiation experience OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience with deal strategy, deal execution, and contractual negotiations.
* 5+ years of experience in customer-facing commercial roles and presenting to C-Level executives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Seasoned sales and negotiation professional, unafraid of conflict.
* Positive attitude and passion for working with customers and partners.
* Comfortable speaking at all organizational levels — from CxO to procurement / purchasing teams.
* Strategic, long-term thinker, able to analyze data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Team player and collaborative — high-performing individualists will not succeed in this role.
* In-depth and strategic understanding of licensing, cloud principles and contracting.
* Ability to simplify complex legal and commercial constructs.
* Proficiency in consultative selling.

**Key Skills & Habits**

* Strong commercial acumen and judgment.
* Industry knowledge and ability to leverage competitive analysis to craft commercial solutions.
* Understanding of the MCEM Framework and sales process compliance.
* Ability to de-risk revenue in peak periods through on-time renewal rigor and early/right submission.
* Active interest in corporate governance and compliance.

---------------------

**Role Purpose:**

GCOO under Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) are accountable for the execution and delivery of key end-to-end GCOO services essential to meeting core client and risk outcomes. Credit Services is a key component of this operating model, and sits is the GCOO - Credit Services (CS) function.

The Head of Credit Services – (West India), will lead the implementation and ongoing operational delivery of Transition Services contained within the Credit Services function. The scope of the role includes, but is not limited to:

* Represent Credit Services in country governance forums.
* Maintain control and governance of Audit, Assurance and MSII outcomes & clearance within timelines. Drive improvements in the control environment and deliver improvements in automating manual controls.

**Principle Accountabilities and responsibilities include:**

* The ‘Head of Credit Services – **[WEST INDIA]**’ will be a key member of the Regional CSLeadership team and be an active member of the “GCOO Services **[WEST INDIA]** ” Leadership team, representing CS**[WEST INDIA]** interests in Country RTB, CTB and Control committees.

* Manage & supervise the KRI´s & KPI´s, completion of volumes and incoming demand to generate & implement the strategies necessary to achieve an increase in performance, productivity, & the quality of all processes.
* Operational improvements through best in class process, unit processing times and leveraging digital solutions where available.
* Lead people and engagement initiatives within respective team, deliver talent reviews, succession plans, deploy VSAT work streams and govern annual performance management. Creation of an inclusive and high performing culture.

**Strategy, Transformation & Change**

* Lead the strategy and execution of the CSfunction in **[WEST INDIA]**, this includes the functional management of all **[WEST INDIA]** CSin West India & CoE teams.
* The role is intended to operate with a strong commercial focus ensuring alignment to the objectives of the business, whilst always maintaining strict adherence to the firm’s control principles.
* Execute the Global CSlocation strategy in **[WEST INDIA]** and deliver on resource optimization strategies.
* Take accountability for the execution of transformation and change initiatives (under the Credit and Lending Value Stream) in TS, liaising with resources from the Business and Change teams. Support the technology vision by driving adoption of platforms to be used by the TS.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement across the CScommunity, implement continuous improvement initiatives to deliver a high and consistent standard of service.
* Identify and drive opportunities to deliver long term and support sustainable profit improvement and client outcomes. See beyond the day to day.

**Policy & Procedure**

* Drive policy and procedure simplification / optimization to make the process more effective with a focus on value-add activities.
* Ensure adherence to HSBC’s policies and standards for financial crime, regulatory compliance, operational, security and credit risk as well as for operational excellence and production management.
* Drive decision making process, proactively anticipates risks, seems multiple perspectives and inputs to challenge own views and biases, and escalates where appropriate
* Takes personal responsibility and accountability for our internal and external stakeholders.

**Delivery of Exceptional Customer Service through Operational Excellence**

* Define **[WEST INDIA]** goals in Production Quality, Service Quality, Financial Performance, and Operational Risk that enable GCOO strategy and overall efficiency of the post approval credit process.
* Implement global defined Customer and Risk centric Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for CS in **[WEST INDIA]** and ensure delivery of service within the agreed SLAs.
* Accountable to ensure appropriate standards of vendor management and vendor risk management are applied.
* Continuously seeks ways to improve effectiveness and productivity by reducing complexity, increasing client service, and rationalizing processes and costs.

**Risk and Control Management**

* Develop process controls to closely manage the lending process and ensure adherence to policy and standards.
* Ensure the organization strictly adheres to internal control policies and that all activities are conducted in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements.
* Accountable for ensuring effective controls are in place to manage operational, regulatory, information security, contingency, vendor, and fraud risk.
* Establish proactive partnerships with other key stakeholders, including GCOO, Risk, Transformation, and Technology to support service and product development initiatives.

**Accountabilities for Business, Customers and Stakeholders**

* Accountable for the provision of CS function in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs and risk and control appetite.
* Ensure the global operating model is maintained and delivered consistently across all segments, and teams.
* Participate in relevant regulatory change initiatives and operational risk related forums / committees.
* Ensure teams are operating in alignment to global principles and target operating model to deliver a best-in-class service
* Response for the overall engagement model with the Business and is expected as a minimum to maintain a regular dialogue with key stakeholders to review performance, identify common issues as well as represent CSin various business and governance forums.
* Develop organizational plans, budgets, and financial controls to meet strategic plans and objectives and ensure proper communication to all parties involved.
* Future-compatible and client-centric mindset: sharp awareness of present and future client needs.

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* Provide strong leadership to CS**[WEST INDIA]** teams and be a strong advocate for CSwith internal stakeholders.
* Attract, develop, and retain top quality staff, including building a strong performance management culture.
* Lead, motivate and inspire a high caliber CSteam by setting high standards for recruiting and internal team governance.
* Develop critical skillsets in team members and provides a stimulating work environment to attract key talent.
* Champion the voice of the customer and build a culture of balancing commercial and client/customer imperatives at all times.
* Exemplary leadership skills to engage diverse teams to partner and work together.
* Displays executive presence by remaining calm in times of crisis, making balanced decisions, and radiating confidence to teams.
* Accountable for the succession planning, performance management and recruitment across TS, in line with the agreed global organization design blueprint for TS.
* Take accountability for the remediation of all actions across CSidentified by 2nd and 3rd line of defense.
* Ensure HSBC is not put at any operational or reputational risk, continually reassess the operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or West India conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures.

**Functional Knowledge & Key Skill set required:**

* Thorough understanding of the Group, **[WEST INDIA]** and CIB business, including products, propositions, services, systems, sales process, relationship management models, the financial services landscape and competitor developments.
* Expert in Credit & Lending processes and services, extensive Operations Management and a proven track record of delivery
* Knowledge of the changing regulatory environment, especially in the financial services sector.
* Strong knowledge of operationalizing policies and procedures for managing or minimizing risk – including credit, operational, regulatory, and reputational risk – in accordance with the Group Standards Manual, Risk FIM, relevant guidelines and standards
* Strong relationship management and influencing skills, outstanding interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to communicate effectively and confidently at all levels.
* Ability to build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across the organization, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Strong commercial mindset and relationship management with program / transformational change management skills
* Proven problem-solving skills with ability to consider alternative and innovative solutions. A resilient, self-starter capable of driving performance sometimes in ill-defined / new domains
* Excellent planning, organizing and commercial skills including strong financial management capability.
* Proven ability to articulate complex issues concisely and in clear language
* Deep understanding of structures, processes and objectives, particularly in the risk environment (preferably HSBC or another large bank

**Additional Notes :**Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Valeo Health is a DHA-licensed digital and home healthcare platform operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar, with 250,000+ managed members.

We deliver healthcare where our clients actually are — at home, at work, in the gym, or by teleconsultation. Our clinical outcomes are independently verified: 52% member engagement against a 6% industry average, measurable HbA1c reduction in diabetic populations, and demonstrable reduction in avoidable hospitalisation.

ISO 27001 / HIPAA / GDPR compliant. Recognised by Healthcare 2.0, Deloitte and Future 100, and backed by Global Ventures, Dubai Future District Fund, GFC, Shorooq and 500 Global.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and commercially savvy Inventory Procurement Executive to join our growing Supply Chain team. This role is central to ensuring that Kuwa's product catalogue remains consistently stocked, competitively priced, and aligned with demand trends. You will manage end-to-end procurement of supplements, vitamins, skincare, and beauty products — coordinating closely with suppliers, warehouse teams, and the e-commerce operations function. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, consumer-health environment and brings a sharp analytical mindset paired with strong negotiation skills.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Procurement**  
- Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and minimum order quantities to optimise cost and availability.  
- Monitor real-time stock levels across all product categories and initiate replenishment orders proactively.  
- Maintain optimum inventory levels by balancing carrying costs against service-level targets and demand forecasts.  
**-** Conduct regular stock audits and reconcile physical counts against system records; investigate and resolve variances.

**Supplier Relationship Management**  
- Build and sustain strong, productive relationships with domestic and international suppliers and distributors.  
- Track supplier performance against agreed KPIs (fill rate, on-time delivery, quality) and lead periodic reviews.  
- Resolve supply disputes, short shipments, quality non-conformances, and documentation discrepancies in a timely manner.  
- Coordinate with the quality team to manage product certifications, shelf-life requirements, and recall procedures.  
- Maintain accurate procurement records, COAs, MSDS, and supplier documentation for audit readiness.

**Cost & Budget Management**  
- Track procurement spend against budget and identify opportunities for savings through strategic sourcing or consolidation.  
- Prepare regular reports on purchase orders, landed costs, inventory turnover, and supplier lead times.  
**-** Support financial reconciliation by coordinating closely with the Finance team on invoice approvals and GRN matching.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**  
- Liaise with the warehouse and fulfilment team to coordinate inbound shipments, receiving schedules, and storage allocation.  
- Work with the product and marketing teams to support new product introduction (NPI) timelines.  
- Partner with the Valeo health team on shared product lines to align procurement strategies across both brands.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**  
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Pharmacy, Nutrition Science, or a related field.  
- 2–4 years of experience in procurement, inventory management, or supply chain within FMCG, healthcare, nutraceuticals, or e-commerce.  
- Proven track record of supplier negotiation and cost reduction in a product-based business.  
- Experience working with ERP or inventory management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Shopify- integrated tools).  
- Solid understanding of GCC import regulations and customs procedures for health and wellness products.  
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for demand modelling, PO tracking, and stock analysis.  
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks for food supplements and cosmetics in the UAE/GCC is a strong plus.  
- Prior experience in a D2C or e-commerce supply chain environment is highly desirable.

**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret sales data, inventory reports, and market trends to drive procurement decisions.
* Negotiation: Confident negotiator who can secure favourable commercial terms without compromising supplier relationships.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous with documentation, compliance records, and data accuracy.
* Communication: Clear communicator with internal stakeholders, international suppliers, and logistics partners.
* Problem Solving: Proactive in identifying supply risks and resolving operational issues under time pressure.
* Adaptability: Comfortable operating in a high-growth, rapidly evolving e-commerce environment.
* Time Management: Skilled at prioritising across multiple categories and concurrent purchase orders.
* Integrity: Maintains ethical sourcing standards in line with Kuwa's commitment to quality and sustainability

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. ***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***

The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python

* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Customer and partner success

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

title: AR Assistant II-2
description:
**General Position Summary** **:**

This position of Accounts Receivable Specialist will include functional system support related to accounts receivable processes within multiple ERP systems, balancing all cash entries, reconciling all companies, running appropriate reports, and distributing to management. The position also includes customer setups in multiple ERP systems and assisting divisions on customer accounts/problems. This includes maintaining all A/R files including invoices, credit memos, cash receipts, reports, and bank statements. This includes daily collection efforts, to include calls/emails to customers and internal employees. Generate and distribute the A/R problem collection notice. Monitor accounts throughout the month and Month-end Closing. The role requires high attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple portfolios.

  

**Essential Functions/Major Responsibilities** **:**

Responsible for all accounts receivable duties that pertain to the collection, cash applications, and research into customer claims.

* Contact customers on all past due items such as invoices, claims, billings, etc. Document all correspondence with customers, whether by phone, e-mail, video, related to payment for open items.
* Identifies, researches, and validates all customer deductions, i.e., claims or short pays, taken on payments.
* Assist in gathering documents related to billing data (PODs, POs, Invoice copies, etc.) and route to proper owners of the information when unavailable.
* Claims commonly researched are for shortages, pricing discrepancies, promotional allowances, return of resalable merchandise, return of defective merchandise, and various violations.
* Generates cash batches in the system to facilitate the application of incoming cash receipts.
* Utilize tools such as Dunning process, SAP, ESKER to collect receivables.
* Verifies the accuracy of the payments that have been keyed by the lockbox for all payments.
* Retrieves any payment remittance information not forwarded by the lock boxes.
* Researches the individual payments and deductions on each remittance for appropriate coding, value, and accuracy.
* Processes customer payments received via credit card by submitting confidential information for payment through the banking system.
* Matches customer debit memos with the incoming claims and then appropriately codes based on the description noted on the claim.
* Ensures accurate follow-up with the Customer Service Department, IT Department, Distribution Centers, Sales Field Personnel, Sales Representatives, Freight Carriers, and customers.
* Processes valid claims for crediting and pursues invalid deductions for repayment.
* Provides the customer with documentation to help them verify and validate their open balances with prAna or SAP, in addition to electronic statements that are sent monthly.
* Provides information such as open aging reports, invoice copies, Bills of Ladings, proofs of delivery, and credit memos.
* Reconciles accounts by reviewing aging reports for matching invoices, credit memos, payments, debit memos, etc.
Works in conjunction with the Customer Service or Sales Departments for the creation of outstanding account receivable items, billings/credit memos to accurate the account receivable for any errors in those departments, or in the field.  

**Skills needed to be successful in this role:**

* Good oral and written communication skills.
* Able to articulate and understand persuasive writing to perform the minimum standards of their duties.
* Confirmed understanding of shipping, receiving, order production, credit, collections, cash receipts and applications, claims investigation, promotions, and compliance issues.
* Able to work in a high volume and results oriented environment.
* Able to meet multiple deadlines while ensuring minimal errors.
* Requires communication with all levels of personnel at the corporate level, the customer base level, and with Sales Representatives.
* High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results-orientation
* Organizational Skills: Filing, Faxing, Copying, Data Entry, Document Control
* Software: MS Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), Windows, Acrobat, Snag It, WinZip
Accounts Receivable: Invoicing, Collections, Trial Balance  

**Supervisory Responsibility** **:**

None

  

**Interpersonal Contacts** **:**

Incumbents have regular contact with others, both inside and outside the organization. Position interacts with all levels in the organization including interaction with key executives throughout the business in the US and Canada.

  

**Specific Job Skills** **:**

* Possess strong negotiation, influencing, and business partnering skills.
* Possess an understanding of financial statement analysis in addition to accounting practices, including accrual accounting methods
* Ability to analyze accounting and/or credit documents for accuracy & challenge questionable data.
* Possess an advanced level of computer skills including MS Office
* Possess excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* Ability to manage, lead and motivate direct reports.
* Ability to collaborate remotely with the manager and work remotely from other key inter-company business contacts.
* Must have excellent organizational skills, the ability to prioritize projects, and attention to detail.
Extremely well-developed ability to read, write, and speak English.  

  

**Education and/or Experience** **:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Business or relevant educational background

**Minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in an accounts receivable environment** with increasingly higher levels of responsibility including management level experience. Preference for credit experience selling to retailers in the footwear, apparel, or outdoor industry.

Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret root cause issues throughout the process.

**Job Summary**

The Community Executive is responsible for the smooth day-to-day functioning of the GoSpaze co-working centre. The role includes facility operations, housekeeping supervision, vendor coordination, inventory control, and handling walk-in clients and member interactions. The executive ensures a clean, safe, and welcoming environment while supporting client enquiries and converting walk-ins into potential leads through coordination with the sales team.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**Centre & Facility Management**

* Manage daily operations of the co-working centre to ensure uninterrupted services.
* Ensure the centre is clean, safe, and well-maintained at all times.
* Conduct regular inspections of common areas, workstations, meeting rooms, washrooms, and pantry.

**Housekeeping Management**

* Monitor washrooms, pantry, and common areas regularly.

**Vendor Management**

* Track vendor performance and ensure timely service delivery.
* Raise service requests and follow up until closure.

**Inventory & Stock Management**

* Maintain inventory of office supplies, pantry items, housekeeping materials, and consumables.
* Monitor stock levels and initiate purchase requests when required.
* Maintain accurate stock records and support cost control.

**Client & Walk-in Management**

* Greet and assist walk-in clients visiting the co-working centre.

* Coordinate with the Sales team for walk-in leads, site visits, and follow-ups.

title: Sr Manager - Sales Operations India & SAARC
description:
**Function**

Sales Operations

**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

**Job description**
===================

The role

The India Sales Operations Manager is a strategic partner to the India Sales Leader and a key member of the India leadership team. The role translates APAC and company sales strategy into disciplined execution across planning, forecasting, pipeline management, deal governance, pricing, operational rhythm and team leadership. It provides fact-based insights, strengthens cross-functional alignment and removes operational barriers so the India sales organisation can deliver predictable growth, profitability and an effective customer experience.

What you'll be Doing

Go-to-market execution and leadership partnership

* Partner with the India Sales Leader and leadership team to translate business priorities into an effective operating cadence, clear actions and measurable outcomes.
* Review account segmentation, territory coverage, capacity and go-to-market execution regularly; recommend changes based on market opportunity, productivity and business priorities.
* Monitor execution across enterprise, commercial, public sector, partner and strategic-account motions, escalating roadblocks and driving timely resolution.
* Provide independent, fact-based advice on business performance, risks, opportunities and resource trade-offs.
* Connect India priorities with APAC and global Sales Operations programmes, ensuring local requirements are represented and adopted effectively.

Business planning, reporting and insights

* Lead India input to the annual operating plan, target setting and resource planning process in partnership with Sales, APAC BP & A, Finance and other functions.
* Provide country-, segment-, account- and opportunity-level analysis, including trends in revenue, bookings, pipeline, deal size, product mix, customer behaviour, routes to market and competitive activity.
* Support quota design and deployment by providing clear analysis of market potential, account coverage, capacity and historical performance.
* Own the India Quarterly Business Review process, coordinating complete inputs from Sales, Services, Finance, Commercial, Marketing, Partners and other relevant functions.
* Prepare and present concise management insights, recommendations and actions for India and APAC leadership.
* Maintain reliable dashboards and management reporting, with clear definitions, data ownership and follow-through on actions.

Forecast and pipeline management

Own the end-to-end India forecasting rhythm and serve as the primary Sales Operations contact for forecast quality and submission.

* Maintain a rolling quarterly forecast view of at least six months, with clear assumptions for product, services and recurring revenue where applicable.
* Co-lead weekly forecast and pipeline reviews with Sales leadership, challenging opportunity status, timing, value, probability and next steps.
* Identify risks, upside and dependencies early, quantify their impact and drive corrective actions with accountable owners.
* Prepare India week-over-week forecast commentary and submit accurate, timely updates to APAC.
* Drive opportunity-level forecast accuracy, pipeline hygiene, stage discipline, close-date quality and sufficient coverage for current and future quarters.
* Partner with Sales leaders to improve conversion, reduce ageing pipeline and strengthen early-quarter visibility.

Deal governance, pricing and commercial support

* Act as the India escalation point for complex opportunities, removing process barriers and coordinating decisions across Sales, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Services, Supply Chain and regional approval teams.
* Review strategic and competitive business cases, testing commercial assumptions, profitability, risk, investment, return and alignment with account strategy.
* Facilitate pricing and exception approvals within delegated authority and the company’s governance framework, including a structured account deal review submission to APAC and Global review and approval.
* Partner with Sales Management to structure deals that balance competitiveness, revenue timing, gross margin, cash flow and long-term account profitability.
* Review contracts and non-standard terms from a commercial and operational perspective, engaging Legal and other subject-matter experts as required.
* Support customer and partner negotiations when operational or commercial leadership is needed.
* Challenge sales strategies constructively and identify alternative paths to improve win probability or reduce execution risk.

Order execution and supply alignment

* Provide operational oversight from qualified pipeline through booking, shipment and revenue recognition, with particular focus on complex solutions, public-sector requirements, partner dependencies and quarter-end execution.
* Coordinate with Deal Operations, Order Management, Supply Chain and Finance to validate configuration, pricing, order readiness, delivery requirements and revenue dependencies.
* Establish a disciplined process for pre-orders, long-lead items and constrained supply, ensuring decisions are supported by credible demand, customer-required delivery dates and commercial risk assessment.
* Escalate delivery, allocation and booking risks early; recommend prioritisation based on customer impact, revenue, profitability and strategic importance.
* Support Finance during quarter-end close with accurate deal-level information and resolution of outstanding operational issues.

Team leadership and capability development

* Lead, coach and develop the India Sales Operations team, setting clear objectives, service expectations and accountability.
* Build a scalable support model with documented processes, appropriate workload allocation, backup coverage and cross-training to reduce dependency on individual team members.
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, performance, development, succession, recognition and reward in line with company policies and leadership standards.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performance culture focused on business partnership, continuous improvement and responsive execution.
* Develop team capability in forecasting, data analysis, commercial judgement, stakeholder management, systems and process governance. Have succession plan in mind, select and develop the team members capability to step up where needed and ensure business continuity is not interrupted.

Process governance and cross-functional alignment

* Serve as an active member of the India leadership team and a trusted partner to APAC Sales Operations.
* Align Deal Operations and other shared-service teams to India priorities, service levels and escalation paths.
* Champion adoption of Salesforce, CPQ, forecasting tools, dashboards and standard operating processes.
* Communicate and implement global and APAC process, policy and system changes, adapting enablement to India stakeholder needs.
* Establish effective partnerships across Sales, Services, Finance, Commercial, Legal, Marketing, Partner, Supply Chain, Order Management and other functions.
* Identify process gaps and lead measurable improvements that simplify work, strengthen control and improve speed and quality of execution.
* Be the main advocate to drive clear ownership across functional teams, manage and coordinate training sessions to adopt to best practices and reduce frictions cross functionally

What you'll Bring

* Typically 10 or more years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations or a related commercial function, including significant experience leading teams in a global technology or enterprise solutions environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, economics or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong understanding of the India enterprise technology market, including direct and partner-led sales motions, complex solution selling and public-sector or tender-driven business.
* Demonstrated ability to translate company strategy and sales objectives into an effective operating model, governance cadence and execution plan.
* Deep experience in business planning, forecasting, pipeline management, quota deployment, performance analysis and executive reporting.
* Sound commercial and financial judgement, including experience assessing pricing, gross margin, investment, risk and account profitability.
* Strong Salesforce experience; familiarity with CPQ, forecasting, business intelligence and data visualisation tools is highly desirable.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to convert complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and lead cross-functional decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior India, APAC and global leaders.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, prioritisation and change-management capability.
* High integrity, attention to detail, resilience and a strong sense of urgency in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

title: Pre Sales - Team Lead
description:
About Us:

Primus Senior Living is building India’s first holistic ecosystem for Active Ageing, empowering individuals aged 50+ to live with purpose, vitality, and connection. Our vision is bold: to build and sell 5,000 senior living homes by 2030, creating vibrant communities that integrate housing, preventive wellness, and lifestyle experiences.

Website: www.primuslife.in

Role Overview

The Team Leader – Pre-Sales leads the pre-sales telecalling team and the Guest Relations Executives, driving lead engagement across inbound and outbound channels and converting qualified interest into community site visits.

This is a number-carrying leadership role, not a supervisory one. You own the site visit target for the team, the quality of every conversation that produces it, the CRM and MIS discipline behind it, and the capability of the people doing the calling. At Primus, a prospect is rarely deciding alone — they are deciding with their family, about their independence. The volume of calls matters; the quality of the conversation decides the outcome.

As Primus scales from three communities to seven, what you build here becomes the pre-sales template for every new city

1. Team Leadership — Pre-Sales Executives & GRE

● Lead, manage and develop the pre-sales telecalling team and the Guest Relations Executives across communities.

● Own hiring, onboarding, ramp and retention for the team in partnership with HR; ramp every new joiner to target within the agreed window.

● Run structured weekly 1:1s covering pipeline, call quality feedback, and one development action per person.

● Train and mentor the team on the Primus proposition, family-led decision dynamics, objection handling and empathetic customer interaction.

● Ensure the GRE experience at the community matches the promise made on the call — the handover from voice to walk-in is a single journey, not two teams.

2. Inbound & Outbound Calling — Drive the Engine

● Drive daily inbound and outbound calling activity across the team with disciplined, timely follow-ups.

● Enforce a first-response SLA on every inbound enquiry — phone, email, website, campaign, referral and walk-in — with defined escalation when breached.

● Own outbound campaign execution: database quality, calling plan, connect rates, and re-engagement of cold and lapsed leads.

● Own allocation and routing of leads across the team; ensure fair distribution and zero orphan leads.

3. Lead Qualification & Site Visit Conversion

● Own and deliver the quarterly site visit target; break it into monthly and weekly team and individual run rates and review them weekly.

● Raise qualification standards — need, eligibility, budget band, family decision-maker and timeline captured before a visit is scheduled.

● Run a daily funnel stand-up: enquiries in, connects made, consultations completed, visits scheduled, visits honoured, no-shows recovered.

● Diagnose drop-offs at stage level and intervene where the leak actually is, not where it is loudest.

● Own no-show recovery as a discipline: re-engagement calls, family-inclusive rescheduling, visit-day reminders.

● Ensure every visit handed to Sales is briefed and warm; run a weekly joint review with Sales on visit-to booking conversion and feed loss reasons back into qualification criteria.

4. Performance Monitoring, MIS & CRM Discipline

● Guarantee 100% Zoho CRM hygiene: every interaction logged, every stage accurate, every next action dated. Run a weekly audit and hold the team to it.

● Publish the weekly pre-sales MIS — funnel health, source-wise performance, SLA compliance, ageing leads, call productivity — to Sales leadership.

● Audit a defined number of calls per executive per week against a call-quality rubric; coach on the recording, not on the summary.

● Report campaign and channel-wise lead quality so marketing spend follows conversion, not volume.

5. Process & Scale

● Build and maintain the pre-sales playbook — enquiry scripts, objection handling, family-conversation guidance, competitor positioning — and keep it current.

● Convert prospect conversations into structured market intelligence for Sales and Marketing: objections, pricing perception, competitor mentions, source quality.

● Partner with Community Operations on open houses, events and community tours.

● Design pre-sales processes that are replicable in a new city as Primus scales from three to seven communities.

Candidate Profile

Must Have

● 5–8 years in pre-sales, telecalling or inside sales, with a minimum of 2 years directly leading a team and carrying a team number.

● Experience in a considered, high-ticket, long-cycle purchase — real estate, senior living, hospitality, healthcare, premium services or wealth. Real estate pre-sales preferred.

● Proven team handling: hiring, ramping, coaching and retaining frontline telecalling talent. ● Strong command of funnel data — comfortable building run-rates, reading stage-wise drop-offs, and defending a number in a review.

● Hands-on CRM ownership — Zoho CRM strongly preferred (Salesforce / HubSpot acceptable); able to configure views, audit hygiene and build reports independently.

● Advanced Microsoft Excel; able to build and own weekly MIS without support.

● Genuine empathy and patience with seniors and their families, with the maturity to hold a difficult conversation without rushing it.

Good to Have

● Experience setting up or scaling a pre-sales function across multiple locations or cities.

● Exposure to eldercare, assisted living, wellness or healthcare services.

● Experience managing a customer-facing, on-site team (GRE, front office or guest relations) alongside a tele-calling team.

How We'll Know It's the Right Person

● They can tell you exactly where their funnel leaked last quarter and what they did about it. ● They coach their team on the call recording, not on the CRM entry.

● They treat 'no-show' and 'not interested' as diagnostics, not as closure.

● They slow a conversation down when the prospect needs it — and still hit the number.

Why Join Us?

● Mission with meaning: Be part of India's first holistic eldercare ecosystem — work that changes how a generation experiences ageing, with dignity, independence and belonging at its centre.

● Build, don't inherit: Pre-sales at Primus is being designed, not maintained. You will set the playbook that seven communities will run on.

● Real growth path: As we scale pan-India, this role is the natural feeder to Manager – Pre-Sales and regional sales leadership.

● Performance-driven culture: A clear quarterly OKR scorecard, transparent targets, and an incentive structure that rewards the number you own.

● Cross-functional exposure: Work directly with Sales, Marketing, Community Operations and the Founder's Office in a fast-moving, founder-led environment.

Not only will you define winning cost models for deals, but you will also lead these deals to profitability, ensuring the ultimate success of both our customers and Kyndryl. As the primary source of engagement management and solution design within your technical domain, you will compile, refine, and take ownership of final solution documents. Join us as a Client Technical Solutioner at Kyndryl and unleash your potential to shape the future of technical solutions while enjoying a stimulating and rewarding career journey filled with innovation, collaboration, and growth.

Affordability id: IND20251211REG002

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
